headline: Google's gemini-3.7-flash hits all-time high; stealth slips
summary: Google's gemini-3.7-flash-20260813 just set an all-time token-share record at 4.2%, vaulting 3 spots in a single day and marking a decisive 7-day climb of 5 positions. Meanwhile, stealth/ox-alpha—still commanding 30.6% of the market—shed 1.7 percentage points in 24 hours, though it remains untouchable at rank 1. The provider-level story is equally sharp: Google jumped 2.9 points in a day, OpenAI gained 0.7, and DeepSeek held steady despite a 7-day headwind of 6.9 points.
highlights: Google/gemini-3.7-flash-20260813 sets all-time token-share record (4.2%) and jumps 3 ranks in one day
